Build UI from declared parts.

MCSS-Lite is a pure-CSS design system where every class, state and token is written down in a contract. People and AI agents read the same contract, and mcss-lite validate rejects any part that isn't in it.

Step 1: Lay the baseplate

Layout primitives own all spacing, and components never set their own outer margin, so any part fits anywhere. Each dashed outline below is one layout primitive.

Step 2: Seat the buttons in a cluster

l-cluster lines parts up in a row that wraps. Primary goes last; destructive actions get the danger brick.

Step 4: Place cards on the grid

l-grid sets the gap. Cards group related content; an interactive card is one real link. A utility such as u-margin-0 is the last resort, for the one override no part covers.

Each field wraps its label, control, help and error. States live in data-state, paired with ARIA.

6

Step 6: Fit the checks and switches

Checkboxes pick any number, radios pick exactly one, a toggle applies straight away. All three keep the native input, so every state is a real attribute, not a class.

New parts

  • c-radio2×, used 2 times in this buildElements __input __label __hintStates :checked :disabled
  • c-toggle1×, used 1 time in this buildElements __input __label __hintStates :checked :disabled data-state="loading"

7

Step 7: Raise the signals

Alerts are printed notices, not bricks: paper and a keyline, no shadow. Severity shows three ways at once, as a shaped icon, a hidden word and a heavier bottom edge, so it never rests on color.

New parts

This piece doesn't fit

An agent guessed a class. npx mcss-lite validate rejects it and names the parts that do exist. This output was produced by the real validator when this page was built.

Invented markup

<button class="c-button c-button--warning" data-state="error">Retry</button>

validate

  • error Unknown class "c-button--warning". Valid modifiers of c-button: --primary, --secondary, --ghost, --danger, --sm, --lg. Only classes from the MCSS-Lite contracts exist. [unknown-class]
  • error data-state="error" is not a state of c-button (allowed: c-button: disabled, loading). [invalid-state]

The piece that fits

There is no warning button: c-button has four variants, and data-state takes only disabled or loading. Retry is an ordinary action, so it is the default button.

<button type="button" class="c-button">Retry</button>

Take the parts with you

Point your agent at AGENTS.md before it writes markup, and run npx mcss-lite validate after every edit.

Designed and built by Gabriel Pule.

Is this the right kit?

Good fit

  • UI written by coding agents: the contracts tell them what exists, and mcss-lite validate checks what they wrote.
  • Server-rendered apps (Rails, Django, Laravel, htmx, Astro): plain classes work in any template, with no runtime JavaScript.
  • Forms, settings and CRUD screens, internal tools and prototypes.

Pick something else

  • Complex widgets such as comboboxes, date pickers and data grids: GitLab Pajamas, Primer or shadcn/ui ship them.
  • A React component API with typed props: shadcn/ui or Primer React.
  • Dense data products, or a brand that must not look like building bricks.

Generated from components/*.json and demo/steps.json by npm run build, so this page can't drift from the contract.
